annotations.title: Check what a Fortitude21 product needs cleared

description:
Report what Fortitude21 publishes about one product's certification: the exact scope of any UN status, its cautions, the documents that exist and what a quotation still needs.
Use when: about to quote or ship a specific product. Instead: un_number_packaging, adr_1000_points, bund_size or decode_un_packaging_mark for the regulations themselves; the response names them.
Inputs: only sku is required. destination_market and intended_contents are not checked against any rule: each one left out is listed in information_still_needed, so pass them when known to get a shorter list.
Returns: un_status (claim, design code, certificate number, what is offered and excluded, scope, verified), cautions, documents_available, information_still_needed, limits, per_market_requirements (a page link) and quote_url.
Behaviour: read-only. It states what the publisher says, not what a market requires, and does not confirm that Fortitude21 holds a certificate: UN approval is granted per design type and plant. An unknown sku returns ok:false.
Constraints: no authentication, key or headers. At most 10 requests per 10 seconds per IP address; above that HTTP 429, so space out repeated calls.

destination_market.description: Country or market the goods are going to, e.g. "Australia". Sets certification, duty and freight

intended_contents.description: What the container will hold, ideally with its UN number, e.g. "diesel, UN 1202". Decides whether this is a dangerous goods shipment

sku.description: An F21 part number or product slug, from search_products

name: check_product_requirements

assumed.description: Each value the tool inferred or defaulted, in words, so it can be checked with the user

cautions.description: Warnings the publisher states for this product

cite.description: Credit line with a link, for quoting the answer

error.description: When ok is false: what is missing or could not be read, and what to send instead

limits.description: What this answer does and does not establish

ok.description: true with an answer. false when the tool needs one more input or cannot answer; error then says what to send

per_market_requirements.description: Link to the per-market requirements on the product page

publisher.description: Who publishes the tool, the Fortitude21 products that fit, with links, and quote_url, a link to ask for a quotation

quote_url.description: Link to ask for a quotation

tool.description: Link to the same answer on the interactive tool page

un_status.description: claim, design_code, certificate_number, offered, excluded, scope and verified; null when the product has no UN status

use_these_for_the_regulations.description: The dangerous goods tools that answer the regulatory questions
